criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Implement suitable classification models for loan default prediction with reproducible preprocessing and train/test separation.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Tune selected model parameters using appropriate cross-validation on training data only; avoid test leakage.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Compare models using consistent metrics including precision, recall, F1 and ROC-AUC where appropriate; interpret class imbalance.

criteria.name: Risk Factor / Feature Importance Analysis
criteria.guidance: Explain influential features with valid importance/explanation methods and distinguish association from causation.

criteria.name: Clustering & Borrower Segmentation
criteria.guidance: Create defensible borrower segments from suitable features, scale where needed, assess cluster quality and interpret segments carefully.
